**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

### What looks good
- Layering holds: `ui` only calls `app::recognize` (`state_pockets.rs`); planning moved to `app::recognize::plan_operation` (`create.rs`) and the seed to `operation::seed_params`, and the MCP `detect_pockets {create}` tool now calls the same code, so a click and an agent create identical operations (the moved seed body is byte-for-byte the old one).
- Everything Is a Command: Create queues `CreateOperation` plus `Select` through the pending queue; the test drives it and one `Undo` removes the new operation for both a slot and a pocket.
- Staleness is handled by name: the scan is keyed by model and `doc_version`; Create on a stale/missing row refuses with "detect pockets again - the list is out of date"; no tool refuses "no tool in the document"; a model without geometry refuses "pockets not detected: ...". Plan errors are surfaced, not swallowed. No unwrap/expect/panic or raw indexing in the new non-test code (`get(i)`, `get(kind)`).
- Provenance lines on all new modules, decision file `docs/decisions/511-detect-pockets-ui.md`, new files all under 400 lines, conventional commit subjects, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #511` in the body. No snapshot PNGs, build, script, workflow, process or dependency files touched.

### Local results (merged with `upstream/main`, already up to date)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 458 passed, 5 ignored (includes `pockets_tests` 4/4) |
| ui `boundary_picks` / `edge_loop_pick` / `feedback` / `fixtures` / `machine` / `models` / `operations` / `shell` / `theme_files` / `boundary` | 6 / 2 / 6 / 7 / 6 / 4 / 31 / 20 / 14 / 3 passed |
| app `mcp` / `mcp_pockets` / `operations` / `project_roundtrip` | 13 / 3 / 117 (6 ignored) / 71 passed; `commands_undo`-style undo covered by the ui test above |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: `gpu_render` (needs a GPU adapter; a platform artifact) and the `#[ignore]`d snapshot lane. The PR's "five known reds" did not appear in this run.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (4130 lines) and `egui_app/pages.rs` (1896) are far over the ~400-line law; this PR adds 6 and 2 lines and puts its own logic in new small files, which is the right direction.
2. Not exercised in a running GUI (the page rows and button tooltips); the ui state tests drive the same methods the page calls.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
